performance.name: Piano — The Light That Returns
performance.description: Revised after listening feedback: coordinated two-hand D Dorian solo, 48 bars in 4/4 at 80 BPM plus two bars of decay. Shared downbeats, sustained left-hand chord cells beneath the melody, selected bass movements and chordal right-hand cadences. Four finite lanes represent left and right hands in two successive banks; 91 named chord cells. A-F-E-D theme: mellow opening, B-natural warmth, an Am-to-F deflection, questioning fragments, fuller return and a quiet E-to-D resolution. Current piano controls, reverb send, routing, mixer and 80 BPM are preserved from the saved performance. No song or lane looping.

patchDefinitions.name: Piano — prepiano
patchDefinitions.description: Polyphonic, sample-free piano using prepiano with no preparations. MIDI pitch and velocity drive strings and hammer; dry centered stereo output routes to Master. All ten performance controls are retained. Notes through A5 keep their existing sound. From C6, a brief deterministic contact pulse excites six fitted body resonances instead of added noise. Hammer mass, hardness, strength and velocity shape the contact. The shortened string decay is unchanged.

piano_amplitude::kin.expression: 0.7 * ampdb(level) * amplitude * (0.5 + hz / (200 + (hz - 400 + abs(hz - 400)) / 8)) / (mass * (0.75 + 0.25 * stiffness) * (0.5 + 5 * position))

piano_attack_noise::amp.expression: (0.16 * ((hz - 800 + abs(hz - 800)) / 2000 * (1 + (hz - 800 + abs(hz - 800)) / 4000) + 1.8 * (hz - 800 + abs(hz - 800)) / (400 + (hz - 800 + abs(hz - 800)))) * velocity * velocity * ampdb(level) * strength / 30 * (0.6 + 0.4 * mass) * env * gate) * (1 - treble)

output_pan2::asig.expression: (signal * amplitude + impact) * (1 - mix) + gain * (3.644 * body1 + 2.475 * body2 + 3.094 * body3 + 7.535 * body4 + 5.18 * body5 + 7.274 * body6)

patchDefinitions.name: Reverb Effect
patchDefinitions.description: Stereo reverb effect, uses inleta channel names "left" and "right".
